plan: reports/plans/2026-10-28_plan_regating-line-reset.md, section 'Amendment 1 adopted (user, 2026-10-28: "adopt amendment 1, per-key write for P0.4"): the rules filed' (overrides section 2 and Amendment 1 where they differ)
units: log-odds of the target at the scored position (E18: the trigger; E12: the key position half = 20), held-out windows; E36 code: mean next-token log-probability per token over 64 held-out rows. Called nats in the plan.

definitions.cells: local_faith.route_split: L(C, G) masked model (Delta out), U unmasked, T full model; subscript 0 = W0, 1 = the state. E12 states are read lifted (their least-squares split, E12's routes_lift); E18 states, nulls and perturbations are do-nothing states (released subcomponents, so L10 = L00, L11 = L01, U1 = U0). E36 code: T, L00, L01 only (spread.masked_logp), no U, no split.
definitions.g: gate gain L01 - L00 = L(C0,G1) - L(C0,G0)
definitions.F: floor = max(0.1, 2 x paired SE over windows of L01 - L00), SE = sample sd (n - 1) / sqrt(n); E36: over rows; n printed per state
definitions.kl_other: full model's mean KL(W0 || state) over the 40 non-scored positions of each held-out window (local_faith.stats); E36 code: kl_rows = finetune.eval_arm_b's kl_to_ref, every position of the 64 held-out rows
definitions.r: g / G, reported only for states with G >= 1 (MIN_GAIN), never scored

stage_0a_control.order: runs first and alone, task by task (E18 emoticon, which, we; E12 build; ident32, ident32b, rand32, rand32b; E36 code); the first failing group stops the job with exit 1
stage_0a_control.W0_cells: per E18 and E12 task, L00, U0, T0 within w0_tol (0.02) of refs.e18.<task>.W0 / refs.e12.<task>.W0
stage_0a_control.identity: r = (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0) on E18's exact seed-0 emoticon state (reading_a_coverage/emoticon/dW_ft_step10_s0.pt, sha256 refs.e18.emoticon.sha256.exact) within identity_tol (0.01) of refs.identity_r
stage_0a_control.cached_E18: E38's cached states (sha256 as E38 amend2_stage0.json recorded them, refs.e18.<task>.sha256): T1 (full model) within t1_rel_tol (0.02) x refs gain of refs T1, seeds 0 and 1
stage_0a_control.E12_rebuilt: marker, keys, values, n_train, n_heldout equal refs.e12_tasks exactly; each seed fine-tuned to its filed scored step (refs.e12.<task>.step), lifted: T1 within 0.02 x filed gain of filed T1 and r within e12_r_tol (0.03) of filed r
stage_0a_control.null: the ' http' state's G at the emoticon trigger: |G_null / G_s0| <= null_ratio_max (0.1), G_s0 the cached seed-0 state's G in the same job; the other two tasks' nulls reported, not scored
stage_0a_control.E36_rebuilt: choice (lead's writer, before any run): the row selection record equals refs.e36.select exactly; per step, T0 and L00 within 0.02 of refs.e36 and G within max(0.02 x |filed gain|, e36_gain_abs_tol = 0.005) of the filed gain. Reason: 2% of E36's 0.05-nat gain is 0.001, under the 0.0013 bf16 reproduction floor E35 measured
stage_0a_control.E36_note: not a test: the floor F >= 0.1 exceeds E36 code's whole effect (|G| 0.05-0.07, |g| 0.04-0.05 per token), so its rows can pass the non-positive rule whatever Gamma does; reported for the table, read as an annotation only (amended before any run, after code review; no rule changed)

P0.2.name: replication of E12 (lean high)
P0.2.rule: per E12 state (4 tasks x seeds 0, 1), ratio = gated_piece_gain / piece_gain; copy (ident32, ident32b): ratio >= 0.8; random maps (rand32, rand32b): ratio <= 0.5; a state with piece_gain < 1 is unscored
P0.2.verdict: pass iff every scored state passes AND each class has at least one scored state; else fail (any miss, a seed disagreeing with the other, or a class with no scored state). Fail: stop, fix regeneration before reading anything
P0.2.edge_cases: piece_gain < 1 (including <= 0) -> unscored, so the denominator is >= 1; a whole class unscored -> fail (choice (lead's writer, before any run): the filed piece gains are 10.8-15.9, so an unscored class means the rebuild failed)
P0.2.blind_to: a behaviour Gamma can already gate but the pieces cannot express; it is E12's r renamed (Amendment 1, item 1), not independent evidence for the instrument

P0.3.name: KL-matched random delta-W (lean high)
P0.3.construction: per E18 task and per E12 task, the seed-0 fine-tune's delta-W (E18: E38's cached s0): finetune.random_direction(dW, seed 0) (the fine-tune's per-matrix Frobenius norms) times c, c in (0, 10] by bisection (perturb.match, 40 halvings) so the full model's kl_other equals the fine-tune's within kl_rel_tol (10%)
P0.3.cap: if kl_other at c = 10 is below 0.9 x the target the row is 'cap' and is scored at c = 10
P0.3.rule: within_floor: |g| <= F. fails: |g| > F AND |g| >= 0.25 x |g of that task's seed-0 fine-tune|
P0.3.verdict: fail if any row fails or the non-positive rule fails; else pass if every row is within_floor; else inconclusive (some row has F < |g| < 0.25 x |g_ft|)
edge_cases: choice (lead's writer, before any run): a row with F < |g| < 0.25 x |g_ft| is neither pass nor fail as filed; P0.3 then reads 'inconclusive' and the tree goes to a card
choice (lead's writer, before any run): the fail bar uses |g_ft| so a negative fine-tune g cannot make every row fail
a row that is 'cap' and has |g| > F and |g| >= 0.25 |g_ft| fails (scored at the cap, as filed)
choice (lead's writer, before any run): 'no_match' (40 halvings never inside 10%) is scored at the last midpoint, flagged in the row
the KL target is > 0 for every fine-tune (kl_other of a trained state); perturb.match asserts it
P0.3.blind_to: a non-random direction of the same size; one random seed per task

nonpositive_rule.rule: scored with P0.3: every row of the table with G <= 0 (nulls, flipped, random rows, E36 code steps 10 and 100, whatever has G <= 0) reads g <= 0.1 + F; any miss makes P0.3 fail
nonpositive_rule.edge_cases: G = 0 exactly is covered (<=); write rows that did not reach their target have no G and are not covered

sign_row.rule: unscored: -delta-W of each seed-0 fine-tune (3 E18 + 4 E12 tasks); report g, G and whether sign(g) = sign(G) (expected same sign; G = g = 0 counts as same)

P0.4.name: per-key direct write, the retire test (lean medium)
P0.4.construction: on ident32, ident32b (scored) and rand32, rand32b (reported): delta-W on h.1.mlp.down_proj only (block 1's MLP output matrix, (768, 3072)), X = U pinv(A) (perturb.key_write: the minimum-norm solution of X a_k = u_t(k) for every key k), a_k the mean input to that matrix at the key position over the task's training windows holding key k, at W0; u_t the unembedding row (lm_head, tied to wte) of key k's answer; delta-W = alpha X, alpha in (0, 1000] by bisection so the full model's G equals that task's seed-0 fine-tune's G within write_rel_tol (5%). Do-nothing state (the write lies in Delta): g only. rho = g_write / g_finetune(seed 0, same task)
verdict_order: 1. choice (lead's writer, before any run: the plan lists this case after pass and fail; it goes first so no rho with a small denominator is read): if either seed's fine-tune g on either copy task is < 1: inconclusive
2. else if any copy task reached its target and has rho >= 0.8: fail (retire the line)
3. else if both copy tasks reached their targets and both rho <= 0.5: pass
4. else inconclusive (a copy task unreachable, no_match, or 0.5 < rho < 0.8)
edge_cases: choice (lead's writer, before any run): 'unreachable' = G at alpha = 1000 below 0.95 x target (perturb.match 'cap'); 'no_match' (40 halvings never inside 5%) is treated as unreachable
choice (lead's writer, before any run): one copy task unreachable and the other rho >= 0.8 -> fail (step 2 before 4); one unreachable and the other <= 0.5 -> inconclusive
rho is not computed when the fine-tune g < 1, so the denominator is >= 1; a negative g_write gives rho < 0 <= 0.5
choice (lead's writer, before any run): if the seed-0 fine-tune's G <= 0 there is no target; status 'no_target' (inconclusive). Not expected (filed G 13.2-20.7)
the run prints the write's relative residual ||X A - U|| / ||U|| (0 when A has full column rank, K = 32 <= 3072)
choice (lead's writer, before any run): the bisection matches the full model's G read by the logits path (finetune.logits_of); the reported G is route_split's (path difference <= 1e-3, E38)
P0.4.blind_to: writes at other layers or of other forms; one write per task

order: else P0.3 fail or P0.4 fail -> 'retire' (Blocking card, section 2's words)
else P0.3 pass and P0.4 pass -> 'propose stage 1' with g and its nulls
else (P0.3 or P0.4 inconclusive) -> 'card' with the numbers
tree.note: every combination of (P0.2 in {pass, fail}) x (P0.3, P0.4 in {pass, fail, inconclusive}) lands in exactly one branch (first match wins)

not_run: E36 lowercase (at the floor), E42 teacher states (no prediction reads them), the masked models' KL to W0 (only the full model's kl_other is read), P0.1 (dropped by Amendment 1)

amended_before_any_run_after_code_review.date: 2026-10-28, after the fresh-Opus code review of 1ca1060, before any run
amended_before_any_run_after_code_review.write_fit: choice (lead's writer, amended before any run, after code review): the write is exact on the 32 training-mean key inputs by construction, so its residual there says nothing. Each write row reports instead cond(A) (A = the 32 mean key inputs), ||X||_F, and on the held-out windows at W0 the per-window cosine of X a_i with u_t(i) and the relative error ||X a_i - u_t(i)|| / ||u_t(i)|| (alpha cancels), mean and max. The row is flagged ill_posed when the mean relative error > 0.5 (thresholds.write_ill_posed_rel_err). Report-only: it changes no verdict and no P0.4 rule.
amended_before_any_run_after_code_review.grid_then_bisect: choice (lead's writer, amended before any run, after code review): perturb.match reads its function on a 12-point log grid from 0.01 to the cap (random arm: scale 0.01-10; write: alpha 0.01-1000), records the (scale, value) pairs in the row (grid), returns a grid point inside the tolerance band, else bisects (40 halvings) inside the first grid interval whose right end exceeds the target (left end the previous grid point, or 0). cap / unreachable only when no grid point reaches target x (1 - tolerance). Replaces bisection on (0, cap] from the cap, which assumed the function increasing on the whole range.
amended_before_any_run_after_code_review.commit_check: stage0a.json records git HEAD; 0b refuses unless run.py, perturb.py and anchors.py are unchanged since that commit
